notes.title: Bookshop Simulator Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
We are ready to announce that Bookshop Simulator will launch in Early Access on Steam on September 12th. We would like to thank everyone who played the demo and joined the Blep Games Discord. Your support and feedback has helped us immensely to prepare for our launch, but this is just the beginning! We plan to use Early Access as a limited window of further development to add more features and variety to the game. Add Bookshop Simulator to your Wishlist today and join us on this journey!
